Anyways, here a brownie recipe
  Prep time: 15 minutes
   Bake time: 25–30 minutes
 Unsalted Butter, 1/2 cup, melted    Granulated Sugar, 1 cup
 Large Eggs, 2  
 Vanilla Extract, 1 tbsp
 Cocoa Powder, 1/2 cup
 All-Purpose Flour, 1/2 cup
 Salt, 1/4 tsp
 Chocolate Chips, 1/2 cup
Instructions
 Prep the Oven and Pan
Preheat your oven to 350°F. Grease an 8x8-inch baking pan with butter.
 Cream the Butter and Sugar
In a large bowl, mix the melted butter and sugar together vigorously for about a minute.

 Add the Wet Ingredients
Add the eggs and vanilla extract. Mix again until the mixture looks pale and slightly fluffy.
 Mix in the Dries
Sift in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt. Mix the ingredients together, over mixing at this part will make the brownies tough instead of fudgy.
 Bake
Pour the batter into the prepared pan and smooth the top. Bake for 25–30 minutes.
 Use theToothpick Test, Stick a toothpick into the center. It should come out clean.
 The Hardest Part: Waiting
Let the brownies cool without teying to eat one. If you cut them while they are hot, they will fall apart. For better, put them in the fridge for about half and hour before cutting.
